name: FCX vs NEM Pair Trade: Copper/Gold Regime Filter
description: Pair trade analysis of FCX/NEM price ratio with copper-to-gold commodity cycle regime filter. Computes 60-day rolling z-score of the ratio, identifies cheap signals (z < -2.0σ), and splits forward ratio returns (5d, 10d, 20d) by whether copper is outperforming gold (HG/GC ratio above 100-day SMA). Tests whether the mean-reversion long-ratio trade only works in copper-outperformance regimes.
source:
# FCX vs NEM Pair Trade — Copper/Gold Regime Filter
# Price ratio + 60d rolling z-score, cheap signal at z < -2.0σ
# Copper/gold ratio regime: HG/GC above 100d SMA = copper outperforming
# Forward ratio returns at 5d, 10d, 20d split by regime

# --- Data: Equities ---
fcx = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()

# --- Data: Commodity Regime (Copper & Gold Futures) ---
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()

hg_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

gc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

# ffill to handle calendar misalignment (futures vs stocks)
hg_close = ffill(hg_cont.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc_cont.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Ratio & Regime ---
cu_au_ratio = hg_close / gc_close
cu_au_ma = ma(period=100, type=MAType.sma)(cu_au_ratio)
copper_up = is_valid(cu_au_ma) and cu_au_ratio > cu_au_ma

# --- FCX/NEM Price Ratio ---
ratio = fcx.c / nem.c

# --- Rolling Z-Score (60-day window) ---
z = zscore(window=60)(ratio)

# --- Cheap Signal Detection (z < -2.0) ---
is_cheap = is_valid(z) and z < -2.0

# --- Forward Returns on the Ratio ---
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(ratio)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10)(ratio)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(ratio)

# --- Split Cheap Signal by Copper Regime ---
# Cheap + copper outperforming (favorable regime)
cheap_cu_up_5d = where(is_cheap and copper_up, fwd_5d)
cheap_cu_up_10d = where(is_cheap and copper_up, fwd_10d)
cheap_cu_up_20d = where(is_cheap and copper_up, fwd_20d)

# Cheap + copper underperforming (unfavorable regime)
cheap_cu_dn_5d = where(is_cheap and not copper_up, fwd_5d)
cheap_cu_dn_10d = where(is_cheap and not copper_up, fwd_10d)
cheap_cu_dn_20d = where(is_cheap and not copper_up, fwd_20d)

# --- Timestamps ---
ts = index()

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Z-Score Context with Regime Shading
# ============================================================
# Regime band: 1.0 when copper outperforming, 0.0 otherwise
regime_band = 1.0 if copper_up else 0.0

xy_lines(
    title='FCX/NEM Z-Score: Does Copper Regime Matter?',
    category='FCX vs NEM Pair Trade',
    order=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Z-Score', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Copper Outperforming', color=Color.Orange, is_band=True, area=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Cheap (-2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Rich (+2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Fair Value')
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Z-Score'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(z, regime_band))

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Event Markers — Cheap Signals with Regime Tag
# ============================================================
regime_label = conditional_select(
    is_cheap and copper_up, 'Copper Up',
    is_cheap and not copper_up, 'Copper Down',
    'N/A'
)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Cheap Signal (Z < -2)',
        icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Cu/Au Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(z, regime_label, fcx.c, cu_au_ratio, ratio, is_cheap)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Regime-Split Forward Returns — The Punchline
# ============================================================
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Cheap Signal: Median Return by Copper Regime (Positive = Trade Works)',
    category='FCX vs NEM Pair Trade',
    order=2,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Copper Outperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Copper Outperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Copper Outperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Copper Underperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='10d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Copper Underperforming'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='20d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Copper Underperforming')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ])
)(values=(cheap_cu_up_5d, cheap_cu_up_10d, cheap_cu_up_20d, cheap_cu_dn_5d, cheap_cu_dn_10d, cheap_cu_dn_20d))

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Summary Stats — Regime Comparison
# ============================================================
# Hit rates: positive fwd return = win for cheap (long ratio) signal
hit_cu_up_5d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and copper_up and is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d > 0) else 0.0
hit_cu_up_10d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and copper_up and is_valid(fwd_10d) and fwd_10d > 0) else 0.0
hit_cu_up_20d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and copper_up and is_valid(fwd_20d) and fwd_20d > 0) else 0.0

hit_cu_dn_5d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and not copper_up and is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d > 0) else 0.0
hit_cu_dn_10d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and not copper_up and is_valid(fwd_10d) and fwd_10d > 0) else 0.0
hit_cu_dn_20d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and not copper_up and is_valid(fwd_20d) and fwd_20d > 0) else 0.0

# Event counts
n_cu_up = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Count)(cheap_cu_up_5d)
n_cu_dn = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Count)(cheap_cu_dn_5d)

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Cheap Signal Stats by Copper Regime',
        row_size=4, col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Event Count', 'Hit Rate 5d', 'Hit Rate 10d', 'Hit Rate 20d'],
        col_headers=['Cu Up', 'Cu Down', 'Median 5d Ret', 'Median 20d Ret'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='FCX vs NEM Pair Trade',
    order=0
)(n_cu_up, n_cu_dn, cheap_cu_up_5d, cheap_cu_up_20d, hit_cu_up_5d, hit_cu_dn_5d, cheap_cu_up_10d, cheap_cu_up_20d, hit_cu_up_10d, hit_cu_dn_10d, cheap_cu_dn_5d, cheap_cu_dn_20d, hit_cu_up_20d, hit_cu_dn_20d, cheap_cu_dn_5d, cheap_cu_dn_20d)
